svg.title: PB-MO-003 rib support stack mould
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · CLOSED STACK, PARTS BLACK: ELONGATED (TOP), HYBRID (BOTTOM), M6 BOLT
SCALE 2:1 · ELONGATED ABOVE THE WEB, HYBRID BELOW · THE GAPS ARE THE WALLS AND FRAMES
Release wax + PVA; flat platens + clamps or a press
MAIN PLATE (1), TOP PLATE (2), BOTTOM PLATE (3): output/mould/mould_main_plate / _top_plate / _bottom_plate (.stl / .step).
THE 30 MAIN PLATE HOLDS BOTH CAVITIES: ELONGATED IN THE TOP FACE, HYBRID IN THE BOTTOM FACE, 10 WEB BETWEEN.
EACH CAVITY IS THAT PADDLE'S RIB SUPPORT (SHEET 3): THE MAIN PLATE CARRIES THE BOTTOM-FLUTE TEETH, EACH CLAMP PLATE (10 + 8.4 TEETH)
THE TOP-FLUTE TEETH. THE CLAMP PLATES SEAT FLAT ON THE MAIN PLATE: CLOSED STACK 50, CORE HEIGHT 10, WALLS 1.6, FRAME 10.
PRINT THE CLAMP PLATES BACK DOWN, TEETH UP, AND THE MAIN PLATE AS TWO 15 HALVES SPLIT THROUGH THE WEB
(mould_main_upper_half / _lower_half.stl), EACH CAVITY UP; THE STACK BOLTS CLAMP THEM. ≥ 5 WALLS, ≥ 40 % INFILL. PLA AT 100 %: MAIN 1.8, TOP 1.1, BOTTOM 1.1 kg.
PLA SOFTENS NEAR 55 °C: ROOM-TEMPERATURE-CURE EPOXY ONLY. FOR A WARM CURE PRINT IN PETG, ASA OR PA-CF. BED ≥ 440 mm, OR MACHINE THE STEP.
DRY FIT FIRST WITH BOTH TRIAL RIB SUPPORT STLs PRINTED IN PLA: THE STACK MUST CLOSE FULLY. THEN SAND THE CAVITIES (P400 → P800),
FILL (FORGED CARBON) ≈ 368 g (ELONGATED) AND 350 g (HYBRID), HALF CHOPPED CARBON TOW (10–25 mm), HALF EPOXY BY MASS. MAIN PLATE HYBRID FACE UP:
PACK THAT CAVITY, BOTTOM PLATE ON, 4 BOLTS; TURN THE PAIR OVER, PACK THE ELONGATED CAVITY, TOP PLATE ON.
CLOSE: ALL BOLTS (4) FINGER-TIGHT, PRESS THE STACK BETWEEN 2 FLAT, STIFF PLATENS OR IN A PRESS UNTIL BOTH CLAMP PLATES SEAT;
TIGHTEN THE BOLTS. EXCESS RESIN LEAVES BY THE OVERFLOW GROOVES AND THE VENTS.
CURE 24 h AT ROOM TEMPERATURE, SPLIT AT THE PRY NOTCHES, EASE THE PARTS OUT FROM THE BUTT END WITH A PLASTIC WEDGE.
TRIM THE FLASH, DRILL AND FIT THE M3 INSERTS (SHEET 3).
BOTH PADDLES · MAIN 30 + 2 CLAMP PLATES 10 (+ TEETH) · CLOSED 50 · 244 × 429 mm
